mapper.sql: w.id, w.word_id, w.book_id, wb.name AS book_name, w.priority_rank, w.word, w.phonetic, w.part_of_speech, w.chinese_meaning, w.korean_meaning, w.korean_equivalents, w.korean_definition, w.korean_source_flag, w.english_example, w.korean_example, w.learning_stage, w.selection_basis, w.source_name, w.source_url, w.created_at

sql.if: AND ( LOWER(w.word) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(w.word_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(w.chinese_meaning) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(w.korean_meaning) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM words w JOIN word_books wb ON wb.id = w.book_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY w.book_id, w.priority_rank, w.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM words w WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT FROM words w JOIN word_books wb ON wb.id = w.book_id WHERE w.id = #{wordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO words ( word_id, book_id, priority_rank, word, phonetic, part_of_speech, chinese_meaning, korean_meaning, korean_equivalents, korean_definition, korean_source_flag, english_example, korean_example, learning_stage, selection_basis, source_name, source_url ) VALUES ( #{wordId}, #{bookId}, #{priorityRank}, #{word}, #{phonetic}, #{partOfSpeech}, #{chineseMeaning}, #{koreanMeaning}, #{koreanEquivalents}, #{koreanDefinition}, #{koreanSourceFlag}, #{englishExample}, #{koreanExample}, #{learningStage}, #{selectionBasis}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceUrl} )
mapper.update: UPDATE words SET word_id = #{wordId}, book_id = #{bookId}, priority_rank = #{priorityRank}, word = #{word}, phonetic = #{phonetic}, part_of_speech = #{partOfSpeech}, chinese_meaning = #{chineseMeaning}, korean_meaning = #{koreanMeaning}, korean_equivalents = #{koreanEquivalents}, korean_definition = #{koreanDefinition}, korean_source_flag = #{koreanSourceFlag}, english_example = #{englishExample}, korean_example = #{koreanExample}, learning_stage = #{learningStage}, selection_basis = #{selectionBasis}, source_name = #{sourceName}, source_url = #{sourceUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
